name: illuminance_chain
note: Night scope: the row runs only when aee_core_lightIsNight is true (sun at or below the horizon). At night both sides are the physical-sky model, so the eye scene illuminance (aee_eye_eyeSceneLux) tracks the core illuminance (aee_core_illuminanceLux) within the tolerance, a relative fraction. The eye fix 98d1f17 gates the engine local term by sun elevation, so the two agree at night. In daylight the two draw on different light sources and the row is out of scope.

name: thermal_ground_chain
note: Air, ground-surface and average-ground temperatures agree within 15 C. aee_thermal_groundNodeStack is a per-cell HashMap store documented in Annex C, not a scalar, so it is excluded from the numeric comparison.

name: solar_sky_eye
note: The night flag and the DEF Stan 61-027 night classification agree with the sun elevation. Tolerance is the twilight margin in degrees.
